objective: After measurement-parity work, test the falsifiable single-task undertraining hypothesis without changing the data, base model, optimizer, batch size, or per-step recipe: does doubling the proportional training horizon from 40k to 80k updates make the native task-0 controller meet the already registered repeatability diagnostic?

single_task_40k_eval.result: 11/20 paired; fixed-init3 3/5; registered repeatability gate failed

full_training_curve_review.result: all eight 5k block means decreased; this is optimization evidence, not closed-loop success or proof that more training helps

earlier_lr_scale_design.limitation: The 10k LRx10 result used a different batch/data-normalization comparison context and is not a matched 40k task-count contrast.

alternatives.option: Stop at 40k and infer from decreasing training loss
alternatives.reason: The fixed-init3 gate failed. The loss curve does not establish closed-loop capability or rule out undertraining.

alternatives.option: Repeat the same 40k run with a new training seed
alternatives.reason: This estimates run-to-run seed sensitivity but does not directly test the undertraining hypothesis suggested by the still-decreasing loss curve.

alternatives.option: Change learning rate or batch size now
alternatives.reason: A learning-rate change would revisit a previously explored factor in a different 10k context; a batch-size change alters gradient composition and can break the registered per-task sample-exposure match. Neither is justified before measurement parity and a clean budget contrast.

alternatives.option: Run a single-task 80k total-budget contrast under the same proportional recipe
alternatives.reason: It changes one registered treatment factor—total update/sample-exposure budget—while preserving the same per-step current recipe and its proportional scheduler rule. It directly tests whether the 40k horizon was insufficient, without task-count expansion.

alternatives.option: Advance to 8/16/32 tasks or unlock Fold02
alternatives.reason: The 40k single-task repeatability gate failed, and this design cannot authorize task scaling or Fold02.

proposed_protocol_if_later_authorized.treatment_variable: Total training horizon, 40,000 versus 80,000 optimizer updates, using the trainer's same proportional warmup/decay schedule rule. The treatment is the complete budget/horizon package; this is not a pure sample-count effect independent of the LR trajectory.
hold_fixed: the verified frozen four-task LeRobot dataset root and task-0 episode indices 0-49 only
the same pooled four-task normalization statistics
the same base initialization, freshly hash-pinned before execution
batch_size=2, seed=1000, optimizer, peak/floor LR, policy, preprocessing, no image augmentation, and data sampler semantics
all environment/software versions and trainer entry point

80k_expected_exposure.warmup_rounding_derivation: The installed trainer computes int(num_warmup_steps * (num_training_steps / num_decay_steps)); with 3000, 80000, and 90000 this truncates 2666.666... to 2666, not 2667.
80k_expected_exposure.preflight_requirement: Inspect the actual resolved scheduler and logged LR at warmup, midpoint, and final steps; confirm the 80k run resolves to 2666 warmup and 80000 decay steps under the same proportional schedule family as the 40k baseline; abort on any mismatch.

freshness_and_evaluation.paired_init_rule: Before any evaluation, audit all available evaluation manifests and select the lowest 20 benchmark task-0 initialization indices not previously used by the current-recipe task0 40k evaluation; selection must be deterministic and independent of outcomes. If 20 unused indices cannot be established, stop and revise the design before authorization.
freshness_and_evaluation.paired_models: Evaluate both the existing 40k checkpoint and the new 80k checkpoint on the same selected 20 inits, with identical evaluator, seeds, wait/action-step and step-limit protocol.
freshness_and_evaluation.fixed_repeat: Run five registered repeats at benchmark init3 for the candidate 80k checkpoint using the frozen prior effective-seed protocol; report these as a fixed-condition repeatability check, not five independent initializations.
freshness_and_evaluation.existing_gate: Candidate positive diagnostic requires at least 11/20 paired-set successes and 5/5 fixed-init3 successes; report paired discordance and exact McNemar test against the 40k checkpoint. A pass triggers review only, not automatic task scaling.

output_isolation.policy: Freshly verify both proposed roots and all log/config paths are absent; use exclusive creation and preserve any failed attempt. If a path exists, do not overwrite or silently choose a new name.

stop_rules: Do not start this contrast until the currently authorized three-trace V3 parity run is complete or explicitly invalidated with preserved evidence.
Require a separate explicit user authorization for training and the new policy evaluation; the existing three-trace replay authorization does not cover either.
Stop before training if dataset, base, sampler, schedule, GPU-idle, free-space, or unique-path preflight differs from the registered design.
On any runtime or evaluator error, preserve logs and partial outputs, stop, and do not auto-retry or relax gates.
Keep task-count expansion and Fold02 locked regardless of the outcome until their separately registered gates are satisfied and explicitly reviewed.

user_authorization_record.scope: Authorize the registered single-task 80k training contrast after all listed preflight gates pass.
exclusions: This record does not independently authorize the new policy evaluation or inference.
No task-count expansion; Fold 02 remains locked.

interpretation_limits: A pass would support—but not prove broadly—that more single-task updates under this current pipeline improve the registered outcome gate.
A failure would not prove the pipeline is broken or that task mixtures are beneficial; it would falsify only this registered 80k-budget candidate under the specified conditions.
This experiment would not estimate a clean multi-task-interference effect, validate stage-causality thresholds, or change official LIBERO benchmark results.
